business_model.claim: CBL is a self-managed, fully integrated REIT that owns, develops, acquires, leases, manages, and operates regional shopping malls, outlet centers, lifestyle centers, open-air centers and other properties, leasing space primarily to retail tenants.
quotes: We own, develop, acquire, lease, manage, and operate regional shopping malls, outlet centers, lifestyle centers, open-air centers and other properties.

business_model.claim: Rental revenues, the primary revenue source, consist of fixed minimum rents, percentage rents based on tenants' sales volumes, and tenant reimbursements for real estate taxes, insurance, CAM, and other recoverable operating expenses.
quotes: Rental revenues are primarily derived from leases with retail tenants and generally include fixed minimum rents, percentage rents based on tenants' sales volumes and reimbursements from tenants for expenditures related to real estate taxes, insurance, common area maintenance ("CAM") and other recoverable operating expenses, as well as certain capital expenditures.

business_model.claim: Beyond rental income, CBL generates revenue from management, leasing and development fees, sponsorships, sales of peripheral land, and sales of operating real estate assets.
quotes: We also generate revenues from management, leasing and development fees, sponsorships, sales of peripheral land at our properties and from sales of operating real estate assets when it is determined that we can realize an appropriate value for the assets.

business_model.basis: stated in P3 (10-K Item 7, revenue by property type table)

business_model.basis: stated in P4 (10-Q MD&A, revenue comparison)
business_model.claim: Revenue growth is driven by new lease signings, renewal leases, property acquisitions, and rent increases, while dispositions and deconsolidations reduce the revenue base.

business_model.claim: The principal cost categories are property operating expenses, real estate taxes, maintenance and repairs, depreciation and amortization, general and administrative expense, and interest expense.

The shopping center business is seasonal, with tenants achieving the highest sales (and thus highest percentage rent income) in the fourth quarter due to the holiday season.
